title: Unit Event — On This Blank Canvas, I Paint — Episode5 So Far Away

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint
meta.Event Outline: As N25's music evolves, Ena struggles to capture the true essence of their songs in her art. In the interest of keeping up with the group, she considers going back to her old art class...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is...
Next to that big building... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The entrance... Did one of the students draw this piece...? They're hanging up their art here now?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(They're all so good...
It's like each one is trying to suck me into its world...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait... This one's... Futaba's...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She's gotten this good...?
This one too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's them... Everyone I attended class with back then drew these...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They improved this much in just two years...?)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Is everything alright, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-It's nothing... I just...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Class is this way. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...
Art class

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It still smells like paint...
All those memories are flooding back.)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Ena, the chairs and easels are here.
We can sit... There's a lot of people, so how about here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm really here...
I've come this far, so there's no turning back.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I only recognize about half of the people here. The rest must be visiting from elsewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's him...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
And welcome to our visiting students. My name is Saneatsu Yukihira. I will be your teacher.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: It's nice to see some familiar faces here again...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: This workshop will last for three days. You will not only be working on your foundational principles, we will also be having deep discussions regarding your work. I hope you're all ready.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Day one involves drawing sketches, day two is oil painting and we'll be given a theme to draw as we wish on day three...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sketches used to be my forte... But now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I have to do this...
So I can keep drawing for N25...!)
se_event_canvas_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You're too conscious of your light source here, so it's too detailed. It should be more like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We're drawing flowers and sculptures today. Their textures are completely different, so I have to find a way to make them look distinct from one another...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This looks all wrong...
Is it because I haven't drawn any sculptures in so long?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is my light source in the wrong place?
Is that why my drawing looks like it has no depth...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What am I supposed to do...?
I know I need to look more carefully when I'm doing this...)
se_event_canvas_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, my pencil...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, Futaba...
My pencil rolled your way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She's so focused...
She probably didn't even hear me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, it just means she's that serious about this. I should pick my pencil back up and...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?
No way...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Her sketch looks so real. No one ever goes this far. Her shadowing's so detailed too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The way she used intermediate tones almost looks professional...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Everything okay, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I have to keep drawing...
My sketch isn't anywhere near done.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, don't let your eyes wander...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Just keep drawing... Just keep drawing... That's all I can do right now. I knew that I'd be the worst one before I came here...!)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Alright, time's up.
Let's begin reviewing your work.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Please bring your drawings forward.
se_event_canvas_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
We'll start with this one.
Whose is this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, um... That's mine.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Overall, it looks slanted, and the jawline appears bent. Is this really the sculpture you saw, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Your use of shadow needs work as well. It's as if you've forgotten all your basic principles.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Next.
Ah, Natsuno, this must be yours.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I have nothing to say...
If anything, it's rather ordinary. I suggest you put more effort into composition next time.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I will. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah, Futaba's sketches have always been amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's improved so much since then too. She probably had to draw so much to get this far...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I knew this would happen too.
I had it all coming.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I ran away while she and everyone else kept at it these past two years...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess that's it for me...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Is something the matter, Ena?
You don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine...
Sorry, I'm gonna head home now.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Um, can we head out together?
I just need a second to pack everything up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, sure...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: How was your first class after all this time, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... Nothing's really changed...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Nothing's changed...? Do you mean the class itself...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, like how tense it is in there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not only that, I still can't draw to save my life. Mr. Yukihira gave me his two cents as usual too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Why did I run away that time...?
Would I have gotten better like the others if I stayed...?)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Tense...? I think I understand.
Mr. Yukihira's as harsh a critic as ever.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I still sort of can't believe you've been going all this time, Futaba...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What have you been up to since I left?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh, um... I joined the art club at my high school and started coming here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Every day?
What happened to once or twice a week?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: The thing is... I want to go to Tokyo Art University.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?!
You mean THE Tokyo Art University?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yes, but I wasn't sure if once or twice a week would be enough to get in since it's the most competitive art school in Japan. That's why I asked my mom if I could start coming here every day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now it makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Futaba's serious about art.
Unlike a certain someone who ran away from it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No wonder her sketch was so good...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Um, Ena...
I've been meaning to tell you this for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
I really like the way you draw.
So, I'm really glad that you came back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What's there to possibly like...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I've always been drawn to the way your art has this strange uniqueness to it.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: It's almost as if you're seeing a different world, and able to express yourself in ways that the rest of us can't...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I've actually tried copying you a few times in the past, but I was never able to capture your style.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, Futaba, let me ask you this...
What did you think of what I drew today?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Huh? I...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I agreed with Mr. Yukihira...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: But that's not the whole story...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I was told to get home early today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to go now.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Um, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...
